mapping_notes.unified_taxonomy: Uses the Scopus ASJC hierarchy as the common backbone. AJG finer fields remain distinct canonical leaves where they exceed one ASJC leaf's scope.
mapping_notes.wos_crosswalk: Project-curated crosswalk, not an official Scopus–Web of Science crosswalk. Exact normalized equivalences use ASJC leaves; distinct or combined Web of Science scopes stay as separate leaves under a manually curated ASJC broad area.
mapping_notes.source_versions: SJR categories are from the supplied 2025 SJR source; AJG fields are 2024; JCR categories are source-labelled 2025; SCIE/SSCI/AHCI/ESCI are supplied undated snapshots.
mapping_notes.abdc: Only ABDC 2025 codes are mapped through official ANZSRC 2020 FoR groups. Broad codes stay broad; finer compatible source assignments can refine combined field groups. The crosswalk is local and curated, not an official mapping between schemes.
mapping_notes.scope_sensitive_equivalences: Same-name fields in different disciplinary scopes are not automatically equivalent; general WoS Gerontology and Pediatrics are distinct from nursing-specific ASJC categories.
